units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:13">Kidd. IV, 13</cite> <he>לא ילמד אדם ר׳ סופרים</he> a single man must not be a teacher of primary classes.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:13">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ הדר וכ׳</he> a bachelor that lives in a large city and does not sin.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 41:3">Job XLI, 3</cite>) <he>זה ר׳ הדר וכ׳</he> this refers to a bachelor (childless man) that dwells in a community and contributes towards the maintenance of teachers of Bible and Mishnah. Tanḥ. Aḥăré, ed. Bub. 15 <he>לעשיר גדול ר׳ וכ׳</he> like a very rich but unmarried man; having no wife, he has no house; Tanḥ. l. c. 10 <he>וחזק</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 767:2">Yalk. Ps. 767</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>רַוָּוקִים</he>, <he>רַוָּוקִין</he>. Kidd. l. c. <he>לא ישנו שני ר׳ וכ׳</he> two bachelors should not sleep wrapped up in one cloak; Tosef. ib. V, 10. Mekh. Bo, s. 13 <he>וכולן בכורים מר׳ אחרים</he> and they were all firstborn sons of other young men (not the husbands).
